title: QR badge scanner (camera-based check-in) + scan success feedback

mockup_description.layout: Full-screen dark modal overlay with a live camera viewfinder, then a full-screen success confirmation.
key_elements: 'Scanner le badge' modal: live camera feed, animated scan-frame corners, blue scan-line animation
'Saisie manuelle du matricule' fallback link/tab, always visible even in camera mode
Success screen: confetti animation, green checkmark, 'Présence validée', full student card (photo, name, class, matricule)
'Scans récents' list -- last 3 scanned students with time + checkmark
Auto-return-to-scanner countdown ('Retour au scanner dans 3 s')
interactions: Real camera access (getUserMedia) decodes a QR code from a physical student badge
On successful decode, marks that student Present and shows the success screen automatically
Auto-advances back to scanning after a few seconds for the next student -- designed for rapid-fire gate check-in of a whole class

what_matches: A modal exists and is reachable from the roster view
'Saisie manuelle' fallback -- real, this is actually the ONLY input method currently
On match, marks the student Present in the roster (handleQrScan) -- real, functional
what_differs: No camera access anywhere -- grepped the component for camera/video/getUserMedia/BarcodeDetector/any QR-decode library: zero hits. There is no scan frame, no flash toggle, no live video.

No student photo, no dedicated full-screen success confirmation, no 'scans récents' list, no auto-return countdown, no 'Scanner suivant' flow -- current success feedback is a single inline text banner inside the same small modal
Current modal accepts typed student ID OR a name substring match against the loaded roster -- functional but manual-only, not really 'QR scanning' in the sense the product name implies

missing_to_add.item: Real camera-based QR decoding: getUserMedia + BarcodeDetector API (native, Chrome/Edge/Android support is broad; needs a JS fallback lib like jsQR or @zxing/browser for Safari/iOS since BarcodeDetector isn't universally supported)
missing_to_add.notes: This is the single biggest gap in the whole attendance module vs the mockups -- the feature is currently a manual text-entry form styled/named as a QR scanner, not real QR scanning. Needs student badges to actually encode a scannable matricule/ID as a QR code too (unclear if that's generated anywhere yet -- would need to check student ID-card generation).

missing_to_add.item: Full-screen success confirmation with student photo, class, matricule, timestamp
missing_to_add.notes: Photo already exists on user.photoUrl (Section 15 upload work), so this is mostly a UI build once real scanning exists.

missing_to_add.item: 'Scans récents' running list + auto-return-to-scanner loop for rapid multi-student check-in
